metric.name: startup_ttid_ms
metric.sql_used:
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.startup.startups;
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.startup.time_to_display;
WITH
  cold AS (
    SELECT s.package, d.time_to_initial_display AS ns
    FROM android_startups AS s
    JOIN android_startup_time_to_display AS d USING (startup_id)
    WHERE s.startup_type = 'cold'
  ),
  app AS (
    SELECT package FROM cold GROUP BY package ORDER BY count(*) DESC, package LIMIT 1
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT ns, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ns) AS rank, count(*) OVER () AS n
    FROM cold
    WHERE package = (SELECT package FROM app) AND ns IS NOT NULL
  )
SELECT (SELECT ns / 1e6 FROM ranked WHERE rank = (n + 1) / 2) AS value

claims.text: Both traces contain 20 cold starts of com.superplayer.demo with recorded time-to-initial-display values, so the selected metric has data on both sides.
The range's tip commit only renames FeedPlayback's main-thread Handler variable and its use from mainThread to mainHandler; it does not change the Handler or posting behavior.
Another range commit changes only the PlayerPool parameter and local call from newPlayer to buildPlayer, which is also a naming-only change.

caveats: This compares one baseline capture with one current capture, so run-to-run variation cannot be ruled out.
The current run is a non-debuggable benchmark build on an Android SDK 36 emulator.
The traces show an improvement, not a regression; therefore no commit in the supplied range is attributed as a culprit.

dropped_claims.text: Median cold-start time to initial display improved from 425.901458 ms in the baseline to 386.763334 ms in the current trace, a delta of -39.138124 ms.
